content_zh:
第一卷 第26章 失控-《我养的AI竟是京圈太子爷》

瞿爽见章峰凑过来请示她，一脸嫌弃地瞪了他一眼，像看一个废物：“找我做什么？！我又不是警察！你们平常该怎么办案就怎么办！”

章峰会意——这是不让硬来了。他清了清嗓子，换了一副公事公办的嘴脸：“那我们先对每个人问话调查，再视情况搜身。”

一番问询下来，除了汪教授，其余四人都有嫌疑。

章峰的语气重新硬了起来：“这次总没什么问题了吧？再不配合搜身，那可真算妨碍执法，要行政拘留了。”

瞿爽冷哼道：“那就挨个搜呗。耽误半天功夫，结果还是逃不过搜身——真是浪费本小姐的时间！”

她烦恨地盯着霖多多，目光像两把刀子。

“你这么护着你堂弟，不如就从你开始吧？”

她给章峰使了个眼色。

“搜仔细了，里里外外，一根头发丝都不要放过。她这人狡猾得很，指不定把东西藏在什么地方呢！”

“没问题！”章峰应了声，便招呼跟班一起靠近霖多多。

“你不能这样！”霖多多本能地后退了一步，汪教授也上前拦着，“这样不合规！”

“怎么不能？！这次程序可没问题了！合规得很！”章峰根本不给霖多多反对的机会，连带着把上前拦截的汪教授也一把推开。

方才瞿爽已经给他暗示了——务必要让这姐弟俩当众出丑。没有监控，可以随便干，真出了事她来摆平。

恃强凌弱、以权谋私的事章峰没少干过，现在又得了瞿家大小姐的撑腰，胆子更是狂了。刚才吃了霖多多的瘪，他心里压着一股子怨气，这会儿如饿狼般扑向霖多多，恨不能直接把人的衣服给撕了。

就在此时，只听“砰——”的一声巨响，画室的门被人一脚踹开，撞在墙上。

“你们在做什么？！”

一声暴喝，像闷雷一样在画室里炸开。

所有人都被吓了一跳，齐刷刷扭头看向门口。

一个男人走了进来。

穿着普通的短袖和运动裤，乍一看像个不着边幅的大学生。可走起路来步步生风，站定之后整个屋子的气压都低了几分。

When Qu Shuang saw Zhang Feng approaching her to ask for instructions, she glared at him with disgust, as if he were looking at a loser: "What are you looking for for me?! I'm not a policeman! Just handle the case as you normally would!"

The general meeting agreed - this is not a matter of force.He cleared his throat and changed his face to a more businesslike one: "Then let's question and investigate everyone first, and then search them according to the situation."

After some questioning, except for Professor Wang, the other four people were suspected.

Zhang Feng's tone became hard again: "There will be no problem this time, right? If you don't cooperate with the body search, it will really be considered as obstructing law enforcement and you will be subject to administrative detention."

Qu Shuang snorted coldly: "Then let's search them one by one. After wasting a long time, we still can't escape the search - what a waste of my time!"

She stared at Lin Duoduo angrily, her eyes like two knives.

"You are so protective of your cousin, why don't we start with you?"

She winked at Zhang Feng.

"Search carefully, inside and out, don't miss a single hair. She is very cunning, she may be hiding things somewhere!"

"No problem!" Zhang Feng responded and asked his followers to get closer to Lin Duoduo.

"You can't do this!" Lin Duoduo instinctively took a step back, and Professor Wang stepped forward to stop him, "This is against the rules!"

"Why not?! There is no problem with the procedure this time! It's very compliant!" Zhang Feng didn't give Lin Duoduo a chance to object, and even pushed Professor Wang away who stepped forward to intercept him.

Qu Shuang had just given him a hint - the siblings must be embarrassed in public.There is no monitoring, so you can do whatever you want. If something goes wrong, she will take care of it.

Zhang Feng had done many things like bullying and abusing power for personal gain. Now that he had the support of the eldest lady of the Qu family, he was even more courageous.He had suffered a lot from Lin Duoduo just now, and he was filled with resentment in his heart. Now he pounced on Lin Duoduo like a hungry wolf, wishing he could just tear the person's clothes off.

At this moment, there was a loud "bang" sound, and the door of the studio was kicked open and hit the wall.

"What are you doing?!"

A loud shout exploded in the studio like muffled thunder.

Everyone was startled and turned to look at the door.

A man walked in.

Wearing ordinary short-sleeves and sweatpants, he looks like a shameless college student at first glance.But when I walked, I felt windy every step of the way, and after I stood still, the air pressure in the whole room dropped a bit.
